webhooks.description: Send events, such as approved translations, to other services as HTTP requests.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add one to inform your CI, chat, or other services when translations are approved, entries are added, or tasks are completed.
webhooks.enabledHelp: Inactive webhooks receive no events, and any pending deliveries are discarded. Tests are still sent as usual.
webhooks.eventHelp.WEBHOOK_EVENT_ENTRIES: Within the app or via import.
webhooks.eventHelp.WEBHOOK_EVENT_EXPORT_: A download or git export failed on the server, with the error. A failed git export also sends “Task run failed”.
webhooks.eventHelp.WEBHOOK_EVENT_LOGIN_F: Include the email, address, and reason only, never the password. A maximum of one attempt every 15 minutes per email and address.
webhooks.eventHelp.WEBHOOK_EVENT_TASK_RU: Due to this error, the run also stopped responding.
The action performed by the run, such as submitting a git export pull request.
webhooks.eventHelp.WEBHOOK_EVENT_TRANSLA: Within the editor or via an approved import, along with the approved texts.
New or modified in the editor, via machine translation, or through an import that did not pass approval.
Along with the text and the reviewer’s comment.
On its date or when released by hand, with the entries that export now.
webhooks.eventsRequired: Please select at least one event.
webhooks.formatHelp.WEBHOOK_FORMAT_APPRI: A notification for an Apprise API server, which passes it on to email, ntfy, Telegram and many more services.
webhooks.formatHelp.WEBHOOK_FORMAT_DISCO: A short message, for a Discord channel's webhook.
webhooks.formatHelp.WEBHOOK_FORMAT_JSON: The event, including all its details, for your use.
webhooks.formatHelp.WEBHOOK_FORMAT_SLACK: A short message, for Slack and chat services that support Slack’s webhooks, such as Mattermost.
webhooks.formatMismatch: This address accepts only {format} format and will reject other formats.
webhooks.schedule.digestHelp: Events are collected and sent as a single message at these times (UTC). No message is sent if nothing occurs.
webhooks.schedule.label: When to send
webhooks.schedule.noneHelp: Each event is sent as it occurs. In the editor, every saved translation is a separate event.
webhooks.secretHelp: Optional. Each delivery will include the header X-Parlance-Signature: sha256= followed by the HMAC-SHA256 of the body content. It is stored in encrypted form and will never be displayed again, so please copy it before saving.
webhooks.urlHelp: Each event is posted here as JSON. Addresses within your own network also work.
